notes: No target, OE, novel, TX, fitting, G checkpoint, training or new deployment candidate.
C4 mixture and uniform Gaussian match prior moments. Mixture updates component weights from current observation with common covariance and one Cholesky, three right hand sides.
Fixed mean shares the mixture within covariance, isolating the effect of marginalizing over phase directions.
This source-only CPU run does not change the queued C4 E30 configuration or GPU budget.
